clientRules: No direct provider SDKs in the browser.
No direct calls to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other model APIs.
Use the active 0S/SkyGate bearer and gate-card headers.
Streaming uses fetch + ReadableStream parsing, not EventSource.

upstreamAuth.notes: This app inherits auth from the 0S/SkyGate bridge. Tenant/user/role claims should be provided by the parent 0S shell or server functions.
